'''January 2001 Durham tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Sports Cards Unlimited, Durham, North Carolina on 27 January 2001. [[Henry Jicha]] won it. It is known from Henry Jicha's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1680">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-28-durham-north-carolina-1-27-01d1680/ durham-north-carolina-1-27-01], DeckTech (Henry "Henry Ward" Jicha, 28 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-28-durham-north-carolina-1-27-01d1680/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 27 January 2001
* '''Site:''' Sports Cards Unlimited, Durham, North Carolina
* '''Format:''' [[Death Star II Closed Environment]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Henry Jicha]]
